places.quote: we departed from Geneva on this tour about the middle of the month of August
he now proposed that we should all make an excursion to the valley of Chamounix
places.note: Modern spelling Chamonix-Mont-Blanc; the valley is a region of the Alps.

places.quote: which was formed by the river Arve, whose course we followed
not so beautiful and picturesque as that of Servox, through which we had just passed
places.note: Valley of Servox; spelling Servox is Shelley's.

places.quote: We passed the bridge of Pelissier
places.note: Bridge over the Arve; exact modern location uncertain.

places.quote: Mont Blânc, the supreme and magnificent Mont Blânc, raised itself from the surrounding _aiguilles_
it was augmented and rendered sublime by the mighty Alps
